summary: Reproduced the full-tier Responses deserialization failure and the Responses-to-Chat effort drop. Fixed the two self-contained gateway bugs: Chat Harmony now clamps all seven OpenAI strings and Responses-to-Chat forwards every tier representable by the pinned protocol. Full seven-tier /v1/responses acceptance remains blocked because crates.io openai-protocol 1.13.0 still has four variants, while pinning smg merge commit 73b1b2c779a8e088b00987c4fea6a0be24d612fd breaks this checkout against extensive protocol API changes.

tests.command: cargo test --test api_tests reasoning_effort_accepts_every_openai_tier -- --nocapture (temporary regression on base production code)
tests.what_was_measured: JSON deserialization rejected reasoning.effort=none with expected variants minimal/low/medium/high. Raw log: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-54df984c6e53/failing-before-deserialization.log

tests.command: cargo test --lib test_reasoning_effort_forwarding -- --nocapture (regression before production change)
tests.what_was_measured: responses_to_chat returned reasoning_effort=None for a request containing minimal. Raw log: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-54df984c6e53/failing-before-forwarding.log
All four tiers representable by openai-protocol 1.0.0 are forwarded into ChatCompletionRequest. Raw log: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-54df984c6e53/passing-after-lib.log
All seven OpenAI string tiers clamp to Harmony Low/Medium/High as intended, and an unknown value independently defaults to Medium. Raw log: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-54df984c6e53/passing-after-harmony.log
Seven existing Responses and parser reasoning tests passed after the gateway-local changes.
Modified Rust source conforms to rustfmt; stable rustfmt emitted only existing warnings for nightly-only repository settings.

tests.command: cargo test --lib reasoning_effort -- --nocapture with openai-protocol git rev 73b1b2c779a8e088b00987c4fea6a0be24d612fd
tests.what_was_measured: The documented git fallback was rejected: the newer protocol API removes or changes gateway-required types including ResponsesGetParams, ResponseToolType, worker_spec, ResponseTool fields, and multiple request/response fields. Raw compiler output: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-54df984c6e53/candidate-git-dependency.log

gpu_execution_evidence: The affected code is Rust JSON deserialization and request conversion before model execution; no GPU kernel or model execution is involved, so using the assigned gfx950 would not measure this issue.
remaining_limitations: The pinned and latest published openai-protocol crates expose only Minimal/Low/Medium/High, so /v1/responses still rejects none/xhigh/max before a handler runs.
The exact smg #2410 merge commit cannot be used as a drop-in dependency for this checkout because its broader protocol API is incompatible.

No HTTP server/model reproduction was run because deserialization and conversion unit tests directly exercise the failing pre-handler paths; no model weights or GPU execution are relevant to those claims.
